raw_record.question_text: In the diagram you can see a very ragged island. Some of the frogs are sitting in the water. How many are sitting on the island?

method.method_draft: Use direct visual classification and counting. First describe the image: a ragged black shoreline outlines an island area, with a palm tree and several frog drawings placed either on the island area or in the surrounding/inner water spaces. Read the question as asking only for frogs sitting on the island, not all frogs. Trace the island boundary carefully, including its bays and narrow inlets, and scan the frogs from left to right and top to bottom. Count only frog icons whose bodies/feet lie on the land side of the shoreline; exclude those positioned in the water regions. The resulting count of frogs on the island is 6.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有一条黑色的、非常弯曲凹凸的海岸线，围出一个形状很不规则的岛；岛上还有一棵棕榈树。图里共有多只青蛙，分布在海岸线的不同侧，有些在岛的陆地侧，有些落在水湾或水道一侧。
推理：题目问的是“坐在岛上的”青蛙，不是所有青蛙。我沿着黑色海岸线逐个检查青蛙的位置，只把身体和脚在陆地侧的青蛙计入，排除在水道、内湾里的青蛙。按从左到右、从上到下扫描，岛上共有6只青蛙。
